# Deliverables

<!-- Generated by scripts/build_hub.py; hand edits here are overwritten. -->

Everything to open, read or present, numbered in reading order. [`index.html`](index.html) is the hub page: the same files with descriptions. Open it in a browser, or serve this folder on its own from the project root with `python3 -m http.server 8000 --directory outputs --bind 127.0.0.1`. Never serve the project root: it holds `.env`.

"Up to date?" compares each file with the newest decision log in `work/results/` (written 4 Oct 2026) and with the file it was made from. "May be out of date" means the file is older, so its numbers or wording may lag; the last column names the builder to re-run when a file is missing.
